selection_rule: Six ordinary-prose passages selected before Stage 7 generation to span narration, plain dialogue, questions, exclamations, and short/long dialogue; no pitch result was observed during selection.

passages.speaker: NARRATOR
passages.text: They had blond hair, red hair, and brown hair…some even had blue or green hair, among others, and they were wearing armor, or black robes, or the kind of costume a dancer might wear…that sort of thing.

passages.speaker: MAN 1
passages.text: I’m going to remember your face, you bitch. The next time we see you it won’t go this well for you.

passages.speaker: Subaru
passages.text: Without a little bit more of a welfare safety-net thing going on, a laid-back guy like myself isn’t going to be able to deal, you know?

passages.speaker: MAN
passages.text: Wait a second! If you’re not after this guy, then we’re not involved! I bet it was that girl from before!

passages.speaker: FELT
passages.text: Wait. Our cards have been played, but that doesn’t mean I’m not going to try to sweeten the deal.

passages.speaker: Emilia
passages.text: Wait, Reinhard. I understand that it is hard to let her off without a word, but she didn’t realize how much this badge is worth. Plus, I do not find fault with her. It was my fault that I let it get stolen in the first place.
